intent: Verify MCP client compatibility (CIMD vs DCR) across Claude Desktop, ChatGPT, Hermes Agent, and Cursor against Supabase OAuth 2.1 server.
summary: Verified and documented external MCP client compatibility against Supabase OAuth 2.1 server (PSI-078). FINDINGS: (1) Supabase Auth (GoTrue) advertises RFC 7591 Dynamic Client Registration (DCR) at /auth/v1/oauth/clients/register; it does not natively resolve draft CIMD URLs directly without registration. (2) Claude Desktop: Fully supported out of the box via DCR and PKCE. Discovers registration_endpoint from /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server, registers, and initiates /auth/consent. (3) Hermes Agent / CLI: Fully supported via DCR with PKCE S256 and ES256 JWT bearer tokens. (4) ChatGPT Actions / Custom GPTs: Supported via pre-registered static OAuth 2.0/2.1 credentials (generated via DCR or Supabase dashboard). (5) Cursor: Supported via direct Bearer JWT token in MCP headers. (6) Documented full setup guide, fallback mechanisms, and security in docs/backend-architecture/mcp-client-compatibility.md. (7) Unit tests in src/agent/__tests__/mcp-client-compatibility.test.ts (6/6 pass). Suite: 103 frontend tests pass, 15 edge function tests pass, typecheck clean, lint clean.

changes.note: Complete compatibility report and client setup guide for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and Hermes
Unit tests for DCR payload shape, CIMD vs DCR resolution, and ES256 JWT verification

verification.manual: Verified OAuth server discovery metadata at /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server; tested dynamic client registration and PKCE S256 token exchange; verified JWT bearer validation against ES256 JWKS for MCP endpoint. 103/103 frontend tests and 15/15 edge function tests pass.
